headline: Audi Considers Additional $3 Billion Investment for Georgia Assembly Plant
summary: Audi is considering an additional $3 billion second phase for its planned US assembly plant near Macon, Georgia.
why: Multi-billion-dollar automotive manufacturing investments indicate long-term capital allocation commitments to regional production capacity.

impacts.name: Audi AG
impacts.why: Expanding manufacturing infrastructure involves substantial capital expenditure outlays.
